_comment: PER-PERSON erasure classification (account deletion + staff erasure), consumed by lib/gdpr/user-erasure.ts and handed as arrays to public.privacy_user_erase_in_org / privacy_user_identity_scrub (20261313). Keys are 'table.column' where the column references a user. Every HARD link (NOT NULL column, or ON DELETE CASCADE/RESTRICT) on an org-scoped table MUST appear in exactly one of delete / scrub / conditional / retain — the SQL primitive raises on an unclassified one and the integration drift guard fails CI. Every OTHER (nullable, ON DELETE SET NULL) reference is PSEUDONYMISED by default: the company's record is left intact and stops identifying the person because the identity it points at is destroyed or replaced by a placeholder. Held as JSON (not .ts) for the same reason as org-tables.json: the table-name census scans walk only .ts/.tsx.

delete.memberships.user_id: access grant — the membership itself; cascades membership_permissions + staff_qualifications
delete.job_assignments.user_id: worker-to-job assignment graph — operational, exists only for the person
delete.rota_entries.user_id: shift schedule for the person — operational planning, not the working-time record (time_entries is)
delete.notifications.user_id: in-app notifications addressed to the person
delete.notification_email_queue.user_id: queued outbound email carrying the person's address
delete.push_subscriptions.user_id: the person's browser/device push endpoints and keys
delete.push_deliveries.user_id: queued push sends to the person's devices
delete.sms_deliveries.user_id: queued SMS sends carrying the person's number
delete.ai_employee_budget_limits.user_id: per-person AI spend cap (configuration about the person)
delete.form_import_drafts.created_by: document-import drafts the person uploaded (CVs, certificates) — the stored file is removed through the Storage API first
delete.ai_quote_drafts.created_by: AI drafting history the person generated (prompt-derived content)

scrub.time_entries.user_id: RETAIN ROW: working-time record (Working Time Regulations 1998 reg. 9 — 2 years) and the basis of pay; SCRUB the free-text note and GPS coordinates. Needs legal confirmation of the period.
scrub.leave_requests.user_id: RETAIN ROW: annual-leave / absence record (WTR; SSP records 3 years); SCRUB the free-text reason and review note, which can hold health information. Needs legal confirmation.
scrub.activity_log.actor_id: RETAIN ROW: the company's audit trail of what happened; SCRUB the denormalised actor name + metadata (the only update shape the append-only guard permits)

conditional.staff_secrets.user_id: National Insurance number. DELETED unless a payroll line for this person exists in this company — then RETAINED with the payroll record (PAYE records: 3 years after the end of the tax year, Income Tax (PAYE) Regulations 2003 reg. 97). Needs legal confirmation.

retain.payroll_lines.user_id: statutory payroll record — PAYE, 3 years after the tax year end (reg. 97); HMRC may extend to 6. Needs legal confirmation.
retain.payroll_tax_profiles.user_id: statutory payroll record (tax code basis for the retained payroll lines). Needs legal confirmation.
retain.pension_enrolments.user_id: auto-enrolment record — 6 years (opt-out notices 4), Employers' Duties (Registration and Compliance) Regulations 2010. Needs legal confirmation.
retain.holiday_entitlements.user_id: statutory leave entitlement record (WTR 1998). Needs legal confirmation.
retain.safety_acknowledgements.user_id: signed H&S acknowledgement (RAMS / toolbox talk) — immutable evidence the company relies on to show it discharged its HSWA 1974 / CDM 2015 duties; civil-claim limitation 3–6 years. Needs legal confirmation.
retain.site_inductions.user_id: signed site-induction record — H&S evidence (CDM 2015 reg. 13). Needs legal confirmation.
retain.inspection_signoffs.inspected_by: quality inspection sign-off — immutable construction-quality evidence (latent-defect limitation up to 15 years, Limitation Act 1980 s.14B). Needs legal confirmation.
retain.non_conformance_reports.raised_by: non-conformance report — immutable quality evidence. Needs legal confirmation.
retain.non_conformance_reports.responsible_user: non-conformance report — immutable quality evidence. Needs legal confirmation.

employer_global.staff_compensation.user_id: pay rate + EMERGENCY CONTACT (a third party's personal data), keyed by user with no org. Removed on staff erasure only when the person belongs to no other company; always removed on account deletion.

account_global.staff_compensation.user_id: pay rate + emergency contact — removed with the account
account_global.mfa_recovery_codes.user_id: MFA recovery code hashes — account security material
